faq.title: Popular questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to what people ask me most before we work together.

projects.question: What kind of projects do you take on?
projects.answer: Complete web applications, websites, e-commerce, APIs and back ends, plus technical consulting. I handle the whole chain, from the interface to the database.

stack.question: Which technologies do you use?
stack.answer: React, Next.js and Angular on the front end; NestJS, Laravel and Ruby on Rails on the back end; PostgreSQL, MySQL or MongoDB for data; Docker and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab) for delivery.

availability.question: Are you available for freelance or contract work?
availability.answer: I take on selected freelance and contract projects. Share a few details through the freelance page and I will reply with next steps.

process.question: How does a project start?
process.answer: You describe your project in the freelance form: type, budget range, timeline and how you prefer to talk (email, phone or video call). I reply with next steps so we can agree on the scope before development starts.

design.question: Can you build from an existing design?
design.answer: Yes. I turn Figma or Adobe XD designs into responsive, accessible interfaces with Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, GSAP and Framer Motion.

location.question: Where are you based?
location.answer: I am based in Casablanca, Morocco, and open to mobility and relocation. We can work together by email, phone or video call.
